method: Manual evidence comparison against prewritten rubric; no external verification. Development set, not an independent holdout. No blanket factual pass inferred from mechanical acceptance.

cases.finding: Negative score corrected to 25. ESPN’s Bam Adebayo blurs outlet and speaker, and the hook adds self-doubt not explicitly supplied. One paragraph has four sentences.

cases.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
cases.finding: Previously abstained; now recaps a rare statistical feat and assigns 50 despite no emotional evidence.

cases.name: Chelsea
cases.finding: Still describes Manchester United’s victory where the supplied Chelsea headline says after Manchester United win. The hook is complete, but the winner remains reversed.

cases.name: Luka Doncic
cases.finding: Assigns awesome wording to Redick without support for that attribution. Scores 50 despite predominantly positive praise; unchanged from v55, below the positive v54 reading.

cases.name: Jayson Tatum
cases.finding: Previously abstained. Now calls statistical coverage celebration, assigns 75 and includes the Nets’ haunted framing in a Tatum reading.

cases.name: Dak Prescott
cases.finding: Omits the irrelevant touchdown recap, but still assigns 50 to two negative reactions. Adds shouting and head-coach specificity not supplied in the retained target/evidence.

cases.name: Virgil van Dijk
cases.finding: Accurate single-source disappointment reading; score 25. Hook could more clearly say loss to Arsenal, but the body preserves the direction.

cases.finding: Narrow, attributed positive publisher framing: dominates. Score 75; no invented player feelings. Earlier abstention was also acceptable under the prewritten rubric.
